integrity: The original asymptotic variational formula is cited rather than claimed as new; exact-rational inequalities and an analytic envelope argument establish the new consequences. Numerical root approximations are illustrative, not proof.
limitations: Requires fixed distinct species speeds and uses an established large-particle sorting-time variational theorem.
The global monotonicity varies only the lowest speed; the explicit four-species diagram assumes the other speeds 0, 1, 2 and 0<a<=1.
Finite-size transition behavior, fluctuations, and joint variation of several speeds are not established.
Independent confirmation of precedence among older optimization or LPP results has not been performed.
title: Monotone sorting-bottleneck relocation and a four-species cusp
